caption: The drawing depicts two separate cylindrical wooden objects on a plain, light beige background. The object at the top is a thick, roughly cut, and vertically standing piece of wood with a hollow center. It shows visible radial cracks and a textured surface, predominantly colored in dark brown shades with streaks of green and gray on the side, suggesting areas of moss or staining. The object below it is another hollow wooden cylinder that is longer and more irregular in shape, with its surface displaying vertical grooves, some tapering, and a combination of brown, dark brown, and lighter tan hues, as well as patches of black and some reddish stains. Both objects are drawn with detailed rendering of texture and richness of color, and they appear to be floating separately without shadows or contextual background elements. There are some small brown stains scattered on the background.
title: Water Main
